objective: report the first Vulkan entry actually invoked and unsupported or rejected by the global game ICD without inferring a gate from resolver order

activation.default: original raw executable pointer or NULL

generation.active_executable_source: generated triangle dispatch plus the current cumulative active configuration through E101

trigger_categories.required_unimplemented: an exact diagnostic stub was returned for a policy-required unresolved entry and the process actually invoked it
trigger_categories.implemented_rejection: an existing executable wrapper returned a negative VkResult
trigger_categories.executable_target_missing: an executable proxy was actually invoked after its raw target became unavailable
trigger_categories.command_poison: a void command retained its first local rejection and End observed the poisoned recording

verification.default_and_invalid_selectors: preserve vkCmdDispatch NULL and emit no record
verification.required_stub: actual vkCmdDispatch invocation emits one exact required_unimplemented record; a later invoked stub cannot emit a second
verification.implemented_rejection: local invalid vkCreateInstance call emits one exact negative-VkResult record without opening the service
verification.void_command_poison: unsupported vkCmdBeginRendering emits one record only at finish with exact command-buffer ID and sequence
verification.regression_subset: triangle, strict global, E075 shared command-stream, and E077 shared mapped-memory contracts pass

reuse: The required deja query returned no indexed implementation. E079 reuses E011's canonical resolved-name and generated dispatch-policy inventory, E075/E075a's transactional command poison and End boundary, E077's exact default-off A/B selector discipline, and E078's per-command-buffer shared-recording mutex model.
next_visible_boundary: after integration and deployment, run one bounded Tomb Raider diagnostic with the selector injected only into the final BVB Wine/DXVK process; the one emitted entry/shape/reason chooses the next implementation gate
scope: Isolated host diagnostic candidate only; no push, merge, deployment, Activity/APK/launcher edit, UI action, Steam action, or X11 action
